recent.summary: A sharp BofA warning comparing AI stocks to the 1990s fiber optic bubble triggered a broad Tech/AI selloff, sending QQQ down ~2.5% and crushing high-beta names like MARA (-9.6%), MSTR (-9.6%), PLTR (-7.2%), and SNOW (-8.4%) as VIX spiked above 22. Capital rotated aggressively into Defense (RTX +3.7%, LMT +3.6%) and Energy (CVX +2.6%) on geopolitical risk from Yemen/Middle East missile strikes and Saudi coalition intercepts. CoreWeave credit stress added contagion fears across AI/cloud names, while AAPL showed rare relative strength on iPhone Duo demand and China's $37B consumer subsidy program.

A sharp risk-off rotation hit markets as BofA's AI bubble warning (invoking the 1990s fiber-optic collapse) triggered broad tech/AI selling, with high-beta names like MARA, MSTR, and PLTR down 7–10% and QQQ off 2.5%. Capital fled into Defense (RTX +3.7%, LMT +3.7%) and Energy (CVX +2.6%) on Yemen/Saudi missile strikes and a US SPR solicitation. AAPL bucked the tech selloff, holding gains on three independent bullish catalysts including Evercore iPhone Duo demand and China's $37B consumer subsidy program.
